warnings: resolved: “Direct before-and-after comparison of the event status and schedule times” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

resolved: “A complete before-and-after comparison proving every vendor and bid is unchanged” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the API-prepared awarded event on the buyer summary page.
Open the stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order window.
Cancel the Recreate Order flow without confirming any changes.
Verify that the Recreate Order window has closed.
Verify the event title remains present after cancellation.
Verify the awarded vendor remains present after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid price remains unchanged and visible after cancellation.
